name: sf-ai-tester

scripts.setup: playwright install chromium && node node_modules/@playwright/mcp/cli.js install-browser chrome-for-testing

description: Mission-control console for AI-driven manual and automated Salesforce testing with Claude Code + Playwright

sfAiTester.headless.description: Run the test-execution browser headless (true) or visible (false). Also asked at the start of each run and toggleable from the status bar.

sfAiTester.maxTurns.description: Maximum agent turns per test case.

sfAiTester.useSubscription.description: Use your Claude Code login (Pro/Max subscription) and ignore ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

enumDescriptions: Try headless first; open a visible window only if Salesforce asks for a passkey/MFA (for orgs without passkeys)
Show the login window: username & password are typed for you, you verify the passkey (default)
Never show the login window (fails if a passkey/MFA is required)
sfAiTester.login.browserMode.description: How the login browser is shown.

sfAiTester.login.browser.description: Browser used for login. Installed Edge/Chrome work best with passkeys (Windows Hello, phone QR).

sfAiTester.login.timeoutMinutes.description: Minutes to wait for you to finish a passkey/MFA login.

sfAiTester.login.sessionMaxAgeHours.description: Reuse a saved login session up to this many hours (checked for validity before each run).

sfAiTester.primaryModel.description: Model that runs every test case first (fast and cheap - it follows the written steps).

sfAiTester.fallbackModel.description: Model that re-runs any case the primary model did not pass (agent errors, unstable scripts, reported failures).

sfAiTester.dataFolder.description: Folder for test cases, reports, sessions and generated specs. Empty = the open VS Code folder, or ~/SF-AI-Tester if none is open. No Salesforce project required.

enumDescriptions: Aviation flight-control game UI: sky, glass and cockpit instruments
Minimal stoic: parchment, ink and bronze, no motion
sfAiTester.theme.description: Look of the Mission Control console.
